headline: Google expands AI-powered Finance platform to Europe.

items.title: The new AI-powered Google Finance is expanding to Europe.
items.summary: Google is rolling out its AI-enhanced Finance platform to European users, offering features designed to provide more personalized financial insights and recommendations. This expansion comes as part of Google's ongoing strategy to integrate AI into more consumer services, enhancing user experience through advanced data processing and predictive analytics. The platform leverages machine learning to analyze financial data, providing users with tailored advice and insights based on their financial activities and trends.
items.why_it_matters: Tech leads should note Google's increasing use of AI in consumer-facing products, highlighting the importance of scalable, AI-driven services in global markets.

items.title: CloakHQ/CloakBrowser
items.summary: CloakHQ released CloakBrowser, a stealth Chromium browser designed to pass all bot detection tests. It serves as a drop-in replacement for Playwright with its source-level fingerprint patches, achieving full pass in 30/30 tests. This tool is targeted at developers needing robust anti-detection capabilities in automated browsing and testing environments.

items.title: jundot/omlx
items.summary: Omlx is a new LLM inference server optimized for Apple Silicon, featuring continuous batching and SSD caching. It is managed directly from the macOS menu bar, offering a streamlined solution for developers working with large language models on Apple hardware.

items.title: bytedance/UI-TARS-desktop
items.summary: ByteDance introduced UI-TARS-desktop, an open-source multimodal AI agent stack. It is designed to connect cutting-edge AI models and agent infrastructures, facilitating the integration of various AI technologies into cohesive systems.

items.title: playcanvas/supersplat
items.summary: PlayCanvas's Supersplat is a new tool for 3D Gaussian splat editing. This tool is aimed at developers and designers interested in innovative methods for creating and editing 3D visual content.

items.title: Local AI needs to be the norm
items.summary: A trending discussion on Hacker News emphasizes the importance of local AI models over cloud-based solutions. The argument is based on privacy concerns, data sovereignty, and reduced latency, advocating for a shift towards more decentralized AI deployments.
